name: Bug report
about: Report behavior that does not match the documented command contract.

## What happened

Describe the observed and expected behavior.

## Reproduce

Include the module version, Node version, command and minimal input using synthetic data. Share the output envelope and exit code. Remove private data and credentials before posting.

## Verification

Include relevant `selfcheck` or `verify/run` output. Report suspected vulnerabilities through the instructions in SECURITY.md instead.
